title: Final Bounded Independent Review of Migration 004

controls_confirmed: Fetch submissions are persisted as UNVERIFIED audit input with a fixed untrusted fetcher label.
Caller resolved URL, HTTP status, content type, fetcher identity, and claims do not enter normalized trusted fields.
Content hash is integrity-only and does not authenticate source origin.
Unverified extracted evidence has no trusted currency, unit status, or product identity.
trusted_price_evidence requires verified fetch provenance for Facebook evidence.
caller_forged_fetch.additional_direct_sql_probe: Insert with provenance_status=VERIFIED rejected by Migration 004 trigger.

controls_confirmed: Repository refuses APPROVED decisions and has no signature or authorization-status argument.
Migration 004 trigger rejects every APPROVED insert, irrespective of a same-named spoofed SQLite UDF.
Migration 004 trigger rejects authorization_status other than UNVERIFIED.
Existing reviews default to UNVERIFIED and trusted_price_evidence requires VERIFIED authorization.
spoofed_udf_unsigned_or_forged_approval.additional_direct_sql_probe: Insert with authorization_status=VERIFIED rejected; API APPROVED call rejected; trusted view contained zero rows.

tests.command: Disposable direct-SQL probes for provenance_status=VERIFIED and authorization_status=VERIFIED, and repository APPROVED call
tests.details: Both direct writes and repository approval were rejected; trusted_price_evidence returned zero rows.

full_suite.reason: The focused regressions directly covered the scoped attack paths and Migration 004 lifecycle; no cross-component regression required broader testing.

production_read_only_audit.connection: SQLite URI mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only=ON

remaining_fail_closed_conditions: No controlled trusted fetch service exists; caller submissions remain unverified audit input.
No authenticated reviewer identity provider, isolated signer, key lifecycle, or verified persistence path exists; approval remains disabled.
Trusted price view is expected to remain empty until separately scoped and reviewed services can create verified states.
Direct unrestricted SQLite file writers can alter schema and data; process/filesystem controls are required. SQLite REAL affinity cannot distinguish a bound Python bool from numeric 1 after coercion.
recommendation: Close the current trust-boundary review, keep trusted price approval disabled, and move project effort to deterministic Normalisation and offline AI evaluation.
